takeovers.summary: Divya Moreau (Finance Clerk) had their password reset by the helpdesk with no callback-verification note, a new MFA method was registered, and the account then signed in from a device, IP address and country never seen for them and signed in to the Core Banking Admin app.

Farid Rasmussen (Executive Assistant) had their password reset by the helpdesk with no callback-verification note, a new MFA method was registered, and the account then signed in from a device, IP address and country never seen for them and changed the account's recovery email address to an outside mailbox.

lookalikes.summary: Liam Dubois lost their phone; the helpdesk reset the password after a callback to the number on file (written in the ticket), the new MFA method was registered, and the next sign-in came from their usual laptop at their usual place.
A busy helpdesk agent reset the password for Farid Lavoie without the callback note, but only sign-ins from their known laptop and usual place followed and no new MFA method was added.
Dmitri Okafor was travelling: sign-ins came from a new country but always from their usual laptop, with no password reset and no new MFA method.
